help: Plus and minus zoom, zero resets, Shift with an arrow pans, an arrow moves the read-out by one sample, Home and End jump to the first and last sample.

sandbox.title: Chart sandbox
sandbox.lead: Interactive charts used by the browser tests.

barHelp: Arrow keys move the read-out from bar group to bar group; Home and End jump to the first and the last; Escape clears it.

raster.help: Arrow keys move the read-out cell by cell; Escape clears it. Pointing at a cell shows its value.
